name: hotel-booking-webapp

dependencies.name: hotel-booking-agent
dependencies.description: Sends the traveler's chat messages to the booking agent and renders its replies.

description: The traveler's browser front end: a single sign-in-gated chat surface that lets a traveler talk to hotel-booking-agent to search, book, pay for, view and cancel their own hotel stays. Holds no business data and calls no service directly other than the agent — the agent is the entire application logic.
